topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: I can't believe I stepped outside to find my driveway empty, my car nowhere in sight. I knew something was amiss when I saw the chalk marks on the pavement—marks I didn’t put there. The note on my door from the towing company was cold, impersonal. They claim it was parked illegally. Illegally? In my own driveway? I’m about to call them and demand some answers. How dare they take my car without so much as a warning? This has got to be some kind of mistake, and I’m going to make sure they understand that.
